summary: byNordic Acquisition Corp, a Delaware SPAC trading on OTC Pink (BYNOU/BYNO/BYNOW), filed an 8-K reporting that on October 9, 2026 it deposited $8,850.20 into its IPO trust account to extend its deadline to consummate an initial business combination from October 12, 2026 to November 12, 2026. The one-month extension follows an August 6, 2026 annual meeting authorization allowing monthly extensions up to August 12, 2027. No target, price, premium or advisor is disclosed. Watch for a definitive deal or further extensions; risk-arb hinges on deal announcement and redemption levels.
